sources.title: Prometheus histogram and summary guidance
sources.sections_read: Count and sum of observations; bucketing; quantiles; aggregation
sources.confirmed: Histograms expose observation counts and sums for throughput and average latency, and bucketed distributions can be aggregated for quantiles; summary quantiles cannot be meaningfully averaged across workers.
sources.limits: Choose buckets for the latency range and do not average summary quantiles across workers; the current document also discusses newer native histograms, whose availability is not established by this live page for the cutoff. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C01.json.

sources.title: client-go delaying work queue
sources.confirmed: AddAfter places keys into a timer-driven heap and transfers due items into the work queue; duplicate future entries retain the earlier due time.
sources.limits: The queue is process-local and must be rebuilt after restart; its duplicate-key insertion keeps the earlier due time, so each wake must recheck current schedule and ownership rather than assuming a pending timer was canceled by a spec change. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C01.json.

sources.title: client-go workqueue MetricsProvider
sources.confirmed: The queue defines depth, adds, latency, processing-duration, unfinished-work, longest-worker, and retry metrics; the default provider is a no-op.
sources.limits: The default provider is a no-op and unnamed queues do not emit these metrics; queue additions are not equivalent to successful Job creations, and queue latency does not measure lateness relative to the cron schedule. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C01.json.

sources.title: controller-runtime shared cache and RequeueAfter reconciliation
sources.confirmed: The manager's default client reads from a shared local cache and writes to the API; watch events can enqueue owner reconciliation and cached reads are not immediately coherent after writes.
sources.limits: A cached read immediately after an API write is not guaranteed to see that write; adopting a framework also requires checking compatibility with the existing controller-manager and selected Kubernetes libraries. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C01.json.

sources.title: reconcile.go
sources.confirmed: RequeueAfter schedules the next reconciliation after a duration; reconciliation is level-based and errors are retried with backoff.

sources.title: Kubernetes JobStatus completionTime and Complete condition
sources.confirmed: Job completionTime is a UTC timestamp set only on success; Complete=True is the successful terminal condition, and completion timestamps do not guarantee cross-operation order.
sources.limits: Validate owner identity, handle absent timestamps and conflicting status updates, and persist the aggregate before completed Jobs are pruned; timestamps are not guaranteed to establish operation order. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C01.json.

sources.title: robfig/cron v3.0.1 parser and Schedule.Next
sources.confirmed: Version v3.0.1 is published January 4, 2020; standard five-field cron parsing yields a Schedule whose Next method calculates the next activation time, returning zero when no matching future time is found.
sources.limits: Preserve the existing API's cron dialect, timezone and missed-run behavior; in-process cron wrappers do not enforce overlap policies for Kubernetes Jobs that continue running after a callback returns. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C01.json.
